2609.29447.title: Frame-to-Panorama Localization and Context-Aware Sampling for Scene-Specific Ship Detection in a Smart Marina Testbed
2609.29447.paper_summary: Smart maritime infrastructures provide continuous access to heterogeneous sensing streams, enabling repeated experimentation, digital-twin development, and AI-based maritime services. However, sensing hardware alone is not sufficient for scene-specific model development: historical video streams must also be spatially indexed, contextualized, and reduced to informative subsets for annotation. This paper presents a frame-to-panorama localization and context-aware sampling pipeline for ship detection in historical PTZ maritime video lacking reliable pan, tilt, and zoom metadata. The main contribution is an end-to-end data-curation approach that recovers camera-view information from historical PTZ video and combines it with environmental context and visual diversity to construct compact, scene-specific training sets. Specifically, frames are localized on a reference panorama using SuperPoint and LightGlue, enriched with weather and solar-state metadata, and selected through diversity sampling to preserve variation across camera view and environmental conditions. A second context-aware stage targets under-represented distant-vessel cases near the horizon using tile-level visual embeddings and Gaussian Mixture Model clustering. Applied within the CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina testbed, the proposed pipeline reduces 40,718 candidate frames to 220 images for annotation, corresponding to a 99.5% reduction. A YOLO26-m detector fine-tuned on this subset achieves a mean AP50 of 94.78% $\pm$ 0.51% and a mean AP50-95 of 75.10% $\pm$ 1.73% under sequence-grouped five-fold cross-validation. These results demonstrate that highly redundant infrastructure video streams can be transformed into compact, spatially and contextually diverse training sets for scene-specific detector adaptation while substantially reducing annotation effort.
2609.29447.paper_summary_zh: 智慧海事基礎設施提供對異質感測流的持續訪問，使重複實驗、數位雙胞胎開發和基於人工智慧的海事服務成為可能。<lb/>然而，僅僅依賴感測硬體並不足以進行場景特定的模型開發：歷史視頻流也必須進行空間索引、上下文化，並縮減為可供標註的信息子集。<lb/>本文提出了一種針對缺乏可靠的平移、傾斜和變焦元數據的歷史PTZ海事視頻的框架到全景定位和上下文感知採樣管道，以進行船舶檢測。<lb/>主要貢獻是一種端到端數據策展方法，該方法從歷史PTZ視頻中恢復相機視圖信息，並將其與環境上下文和視覺多樣性結合，以構建緊湊的場景特定訓練集。<lb/>具體而言，幀在參考全景上使用SuperPoint和LightGlue進行定位，並通過天氣和太陽狀態元數據進行豐富化，然後通過多樣性採樣進行選擇，以保留相機視圖和環境條件之間的變化。<lb/>第二個上下文感知階段針對位於地平線附近的代表性不足的遠距船舶案例，使用瓦片級視覺嵌入和高斯混合模型聚類。<lb/>在CMMI MDigi-I智慧碼頭測試平台中應用，所提出的管道將40,718個候選幀減少至220張圖像以進行標註，對應於99.5%的減少。<lb/>在此子集上微調的YOLO26-m檢測器在序列分組的五折交叉驗證下實現了94.78% $\pm$ 0.51%的平均AP50和75.10% $\pm$ 1.73%的平均AP50-95。<lb/>這些結果表明，高度冗餘的基礎設施視頻流可以轉化為緊湊的、在空間和上下文上多樣的訓練集，以適應場景特定的檢測器，同時大幅減少標註工作量。
